Cost: 500eb (Expensive)
Type: Cyberarm
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)
Option Slots: uses 2

Cyberarm or Cyberleg Option, costing 2 Option Slots. An Excellent Quality Heavy Melee Weapon, used one-handed, that conceals with no check and deploys or retracts for free. The hand on a popped-up arm can't carry anything; a leg has no such limit unless a Prehensile Cyberfoot is in play. A second blade in a paired set of Cyberlimbs cancels the climbing movement penalty while both are out.

Foundry notes:

  • Cyberware items have no Quality field, so the Excellent Quality is in the text only.
  • Corgo allows this in a Cyberleg too; the item is typed as a Cyberarm option, so install it by hand for a leg.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).
